comment: Overrides the root package.json's "type": "module" for the serverless API ONLY. Vercel compiles these functions with transpile-only (not bundling), so under native ESM the extensionless and directory relative imports (./_lib/http, ./providers) fail with ERR_MODULE_NOT_FOUND. CommonJS resolves those the way the local Vite dev server does. The Vite browser app keeps ESM via the root package.json.
